title: DX standup — SDKs & Quickstarts (week of Mar 9)
content:
Meeting: DX weekly standup (quick, focused)
Date: 2026-03-11 10:00-10:30 PT
Facilitator: Priya Kaur
Attendees: Priya, Miguel, Asha, Ethan, Lina (joined late), Menti notes in channel

Agenda:
- Quick-sync: SDKs progress (js/python/java)
- Quickstarts: audit + fix list for onboarding flow
- Samples: new multi-turn chat sample and API key best-practices
- Docs: publishable checklist and required screenshots
- Blockers & action items

TL;DR:
- JS SDK PR #412 is green but needs a short follow-up to land (migration note + changelog). Target merge: Wed 3/13.
- Python SDK: beta 0.9.0 packaged; regression in streaming for long responses (RED-2357). Hotfix planned by Ethan.
- Quickstarts audit: ~11 small UX corrections across CLI quickstart and VSCODE extension flow; Asha to own fixes, ETA EOW (3/13).
- New sample: multi-turn shopping assistant sample ready for review; needs deterministic seed and eval prompts added before publish.

Updates (by owner):
Priya — SDK release coordination:
- JS SDK: PR 412 (streaming + function-calls ergonomics) passed CI, two minor comments from Miguel. Will add migration blurb and changelog entry then merge.
- Release checklist updated: add "verify streaming output ordering with prefix cache enabled" step (we saw one flake on staging).
- Action: add a one-liner in console release notes about the default timeout change (owner: Priya, due: 3/13).

Miguel — Samples and examples:
- Finished multi-turn shopping assistant sample (examples/quickstarts/shopping). Uses JS SDK + conversation state helper. Needs: (1) deterministic seed (for eval), (2) README snippet showing cost estimate per conversation.
- Noted sample relies on model variant v1.3-quant which isn't pinned in quickstarts; will add a pinned model reference.
- Action: open PR to add seed & costs (owner: Miguel, PR: github PR 458, due: 3/14).

Asha — Quickstarts & onboarding flow audit:
- Walked through CLI quickstart and VS Code walkthrough. Found 11 items: typos, missing screenshot for 'create API key' step, unclear firewall note for Private customers, and an outdated KMS config snippet.
- Prioritizing: screenshot + firewall note + KMS snippet fix first.
- Action: push patch to docs repo + regenerate screenshots (owner: Asha, due: 3/13).

Ethan — Python SDK & tests:
- Python 0.9.0 packaged, but streaming regression on long token sequences under certain autoscale conditions (tracked as RED-2357). Repro script attached in linked_artifacts.
- Running deeper CI with longer sequences to validate fix. Expect hotfix branch by EOD 3/12 and release candidate 0.9.1 by 3/13 if green.
- Also started a small refactor to unify stream parsers across SDKs to reduce duplication (RFC coming).

Lina — Docs + quickstarts UX review:
- UX feedback: quickstarts assume user familiarity with KMS/HSM; add "if you don't have KMS, skip" note with non-blocking security link.
- Working on a short "How to pick a model for cost vs latency" sidebar for quickstarts; draft ready for review by 3/15.

Blockers / Risks:
- RED-2357 (python streaming regression) is highest priority; affects customers using long-form streaming in Dedicated clusters. If hotfix isn't in by 3/13, escalate to infra so we can rollback autoscale behavior.
- Model pinning mismatch in quickstarts could surprise new users (they may hit a different quantized model and see behavior differences). Need to pin or clearly call out compatibility note.
- Screenshots for docs depend on a small infra task to expose a test-only org in Console. That infra change is scheduled 3/12 morning — if delayed, docs publish slips.

Decisions made:
- Pin quickstarts to explicit model tags for the initial publish (temporary measure). Miguel will add pin for shopping sample; Asha will add general guidance.
- Release notes: include explicit migration caveat about streaming timeout default. Keep minimal, link to expanded migration guide.

Action items (owner / due / status):
- Priya: Add release note one-liner + changelog entry for JS SDK (due 3/13) — TODO
- Miguel: PR to add deterministic seed & cost estimates to shopping sample (PR 458, due 3/14) — TODO
- Asha: Patch quickstart docs (screenshots + firewall + KMS snippet) (due 3/13) — IN PROGRESS
- Ethan: Hotfix branch for RED-2357 + RC 0.9.1 (due 3/13) — IN PROGRESS
- Lina: Draft "choose a model" sidebar for quickstarts (due 3/15) — TODO
- Priya/Miguel: Run a short e2e of the full JS quickstart on a fresh account and record quick screen capture for docs (due 3/14) — TODO

Notes to self / informal items:
- We should add a "known flaky tests" section to the DX release checklist so we visibly exclude flaky cases from blocking release (ticket idea: RED-2401).
- Consider small follow-up: add an onboarding telemetry ping in the quickstart flow (opt-in) to measure completion rates — spike next sprint.
- Debugging tip: when repro-ing streaming issues locally, set REDWOOD_CACHE=0 to isolate prefix caching effects.

Follow-ups for next standup (3/18):
- Confirm JS SDK merged and released; confirm any regressions reported.
- Confirm Python hotfix status and RC deployment.
- Quickstarts: confirm Asha's fixes landed and screenshots updated in docs site.
- Samples: finalize shopping sample cost calc and add eval prompts.

Appendix (links & refs):
- JS SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js-sdk/pull/412
- Shopping sample branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/tree/shopping-sample
- Python streaming ticket: JIRA RED-2357
- Console infra task (test org): CONFLUENCE:Console-Test-Org-2026

----
This is intentionally compact; keep updating PR/issue statuses in the linked_artifacts list. If anything new pops up I'll add a short patch to this doc (notes to self: keep it chronological).
